wikioasissafety-link-report-user:

wikioasissafety-dt-menu-item: Label of the item added to the DiscussionTools overflow (ellipsis) menu next to a comment, which opens the wizard with that comment's author prefilled.
wikioasissafety-special-nojs: Shown on [[Special:SafetyReport]] to users without JavaScript, since the wizard cannot render for them.
wikioasissafety-title: Title of the wizard, shown as the dialog title and as the heading of the wizard on its own page.
wikioasissafety-next:
{{Identical|Next}}
Label of the button that advances the wizard to the next step.
wikioasissafety-back:
{{Identical|Back}}
Label of the button that returns to the previous step of the wizard.
wikioasissafety-submit: Label of the button on the final step of the wizard, which submits the report.
wikioasissafety-close:
{{Identical|Close}}
Label of the button that closes the wizard dialog.
wikioasissafety-search-add: Description shown under the first suggestion in a searchable chip input, which offers exactly what the reporter typed. It is offered because a report may name something no search can find — an IP address, an account on another wiki, a page that has been deleted.
wikioasissafety-noflow: Error shown when the bundled wizard definition could not be loaded or contains no steps.
wikioasissafety-error-required: Validation error shown under a field that must be filled in before the step can be left.

wikioasissafety-error-summary: Message shown at the end of a step when one or more of its fields failed validation.
wikioasissafety-followup-label:
{{Identical|Details}}
Label used for a follow-up input nested under an option when the wizard definition gives it no label of its own. Visually hidden, read by screen readers.
wikioasissafety-submitted: Confirmation heading shown after the wizard is submitted.
wikioasissafety-submitted-details: Shown under {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submitted}}, saying what happens next for a report that has somebody's name on it. Names Special:SafetyHome in words rather than linking to it: this is read by JavaScript with mw.msg(), which does no parsing, so a wiki link in it reaches the reporter as literal bracket markup — which it did. See {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submitted-details-anonymous}} for the anonymous case.
wikioasissafety-submitted-details-anonym: Replaces {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submitted-details}} when the report is being filed anonymously — the reporter ticked the flow's own control, or they are logged out and so there is no account to attach the report to. Promising to reach out to somebody who has just asked not to be identified is the one thing this screen must not do. Plain text only: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-file-drop: Instruction inside the file drop zone of the wizard.
wikioasissafety-file-choose: Label of the button inside the file drop zone that opens the file picker.
wikioasissafety-file-remove:
Accessible label of the button that removes one attached file.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name
wikioasissafety-file-preview:
Alternative text of the thumbnail shown for an attached image.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name
wikioasissafety-file-willupload: Shown under the list of files a reporter has attached, before the report is sent. Plain text: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-file-uploaded: Shown after a report is filed, when every attached file arrived. $1 is how many. Plain text: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-file-notsent: Shown after a report is filed, when one or more attached files did not arrive. $1 is how many; $2 is a comma-separated list of "filename (reason)", where each reason is one of the short lowercase phrases below or one the portal supplied. Plain text: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-file-lost: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop, because it is interpolated mid-sentence. Used when the submission named a file but the browser no longer had it to send — which should not happen in an ordinary submission, so it means something has gone wrong rather than that the reporter did anything. Deliberately does not guess at a cause: an earlier wording blamed a page reload, which this extension has no mechanism to survive, so the explanation was fiction and the advice that followed it was useless.
wikioasissafety-file-uploadfailed: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop. Used when the upload request itself failed.
wikioasissafety-file-uploaderror: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop. $1 is an API error code, shown untranslated because it is the only information there is and somebody debugging needs it. Used when the upload failed with a code but no readable message; {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-uploadfailed}} covers a plain transport failure.
wikioasissafety-file-toobig-portal: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop, because it is interpolated mid-sentence. $1 is the limit, already formatted as a size. Used when the file is over the limit this wiki will forward — the smallest of $wgWikiOasisSafetyMaxUploadSize, upload_max_filesize and post_max_size.
wikioasissafety-file-toobig-wiki: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop. $1 is the limit, already formatted as a size. Used when PHP itself refused the upload for its size — upload_max_filesize ships at 2 MB, which is below what most wikis configure and below a phone screenshot, so this is the commonest refusal of the set.
wikioasissafety-file-partial: A reason, used inside {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-notsent}}. Lowercase and without a full stop. Used when the upload was cut off part-way, which usually means the connection dropped.
wikioasissafety-file-constraint-size:
Part of the summary of file constraints shown under the drop zone.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum size of one file, in megabytes
wikioasissafety-file-constraint-count:
Part of the summary of file constraints shown under the drop zone.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of files
wikioasissafety-file-toomany:
Error shown when a dropped file is rejected because the file count limit is reached.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name
* $2 - the maximum number of files
wikioasissafety-file-badtype:
Error shown when a dropped file is rejected because its type is not accepted.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name
wikioasissafety-file-toobig:
Error shown when a dropped file is rejected for being too large.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name
* $2 - the file's size, already formatted, e.g. "12.4 MB"
* $3 - the size limit in megabytes
wikioasissafety-file-duplicate:
Error shown when a dropped file is rejected because it is already attached.

Parameters:
* $1 - the file name

Label of an input nested under one option of a question, on the pages that work without JavaScript, where it cannot appear only once that option is chosen. Parameters:

wikioasissafety-nojs-none: The blank choice added to every optional radio group in the no-JavaScript forms. It has to exist: HTMLForm validates a radio's submitted value against its list of options, and an unselected radio submits the empty string — so without a blank option a step with two optional radio groups could not be submitted until both were answered. On the report flow's triage step that meant having to pick something under "Get help with:", which routes to the guidance page, so a report could never be filed. It is also the only way to un-pick a radio in plain HTML.
wikioasissafety-nojs-list-help: Help text on a field that takes a list, on the pages that work without JavaScript, where there are no suggestions as you type.
wikioasissafety-nojs-nofiles: Shown in place of the file upload control on the pages that work without JavaScript. Parsed as wikitext.
wikioasissafety-nojs-done: Shown at the end of a wizard on the pages that work without JavaScript. Parsed as wikitext.
wikioasissafety-nojs-noreport: Shown when a report reference in the URL matches nothing that can be listed.
wikioasissafety-nojs-login-link: Label of the link to the login page, shown on a page that needs an account.
wikioasissafety-submit-sending: Shown while a completed wizard is being sent to the Trust & Safety portal.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent: Confirmation that a submission reached Trust & Safety. $1 is the reference, e.g. TS-2026-0481. Plain text only: this message is read by JavaScript with mw.msg() and rendered as text, so HTML tags, wiki links and HTML entities would all be shown to the reporter literally.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-follow: Follows {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-sent}} in the contexts that can render a link. Separate from that message because that one is also read by JavaScript with mw.msg(), which does no parsing at all — a wiki link in it would be shown to the reporter as literal bracket markup.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-anonymous: Follows {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-sent}} in place of {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-sent-follow}} when the submission was filed anonymously — either the reporter asked for it with the flow's own control, or they are logged out and so there was no account to attach the case to. Plain text only: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-temp: Follows {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-sent}} in place of {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-sent-follow}} when the reporter is on a temporary account and did not ask to be anonymous, so the case carries that account's name. Plain text only: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-submit-queued: Shown when the portal was unreachable and the submission was saved on the wiki for later delivery. Deliberately distinct from -sent: the reporter must not believe it was filed when it is waiting.
wikioasissafety-submit-throttled: Shown when a submission is refused by the rate limit rather than by a failure — see includes/Throttle.php. Kept apart from {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-submit-failed}} because they ask the reporter for different things: one says try again, the other says wait. Plain text only: read by JavaScript with mw.msg().
wikioasissafety-submit-failed: Shown when a submission could not be sent and was not saved either.
wikioasissafety-comment-sending: Shown while a comment on a report is being sent.
wikioasissafety-comment-queued: Shown when a comment was saved for later delivery because the portal was unreachable.
wikioasissafety-comment-failed: Shown when a comment could not be sent. The text is put back in the box.
wikioasissafety-portal-unconfigured: Error when this wiki has no Trust & Safety portal configured at all.
wikioasissafety-portal-unreachable: Error when the portal could not be contacted.
wikioasissafety-portal-refused: Error when the portal was reached and rejected the request.
wikioasissafety-portal-badpayload: Error when a submission could not be encoded for sending.
wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable:
Replaces the login error when the account is suspended by Trust & Safety, may appeal, and the suspension has no end date. $1 is the reference, $2 a URL to Special:SafetyAppeal, $4 the paragraph about the reason.

The appeal route is the most important thing in this message. A locked account has no other way of finding out what to do, because it cannot reach Special:SafetyHome.

This message is only shown to somebody who gave the account's own password. A login attempt without it gets the wiki's ordinary {{msg-mw|wrongpassword}} and no mention of Trust & Safety at all — a username is public, so anything a name alone unlocks is unlocked for everybody, and these suspensions are frequently for harassment.

$4 is normally {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-reason}}; it is {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-reason-withheld}} only when the password could not be checked at all. It arrives as a plaintext parameter, so markup in it is not rendered.
wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable-exp: As {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable}}, for a suspension with an end date. $3 is an ISO 8601 timestamp.
wikioasissafety-suspended-final: As {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable}}, when the suspension is not open to appeal. $2 is unused: no appeal link is offered, because handing one to somebody who cannot use it wastes their time and ours. An email address is given instead — "not appealable" must not read as "nobody will ever read anything from you again".
wikioasissafety-suspended-final-expiring: As {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-final}}, for a suspension with an end date. $3 is an ISO 8601 timestamp.
wikioasissafety-suspended-noreason: Used as $1 of {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-reason}} when the account holder has proved who they are but no reason was recorded against the suspension.
wikioasissafety-suspended-reason: The reason a suspension was given, shown in the login error as $4 of the suspension messages. $1 is Trust & Safety's own wording, or {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-noreason}}. It is a plaintext parameter: the text comes from the portal and is never parsed as wikitext.
wikioasissafety-suspended-reason-withhel: Shown instead of {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-reason}} as $4 of the suspension messages, in the one case where the wiki could not check the password it was given — a database that was not reachable, or a password hash it could not read. Not shown for a wrong password, which never reaches these messages at all. Like {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-suspended-reason}} it is inserted as a plaintext parameter, so wikitext and HTML in a translation are shown literally rather than rendered.
wikioasissafety-appeal-reason: Label for the reason a suspension was given.
wikioasissafety-appeal-ends: Label for when a suspension ends.
wikioasissafety-appeal-username: Label of the account name field on the appeal form.
wikioasissafety-appeal-username-help: Help text under the account name field.
wikioasissafety-appeal-email: Label of the email field on the appeal form.
wikioasissafety-appeal-email-help: Help text under the email field, explaining why it matters.
wikioasissafety-appeal-text: Label of the main textarea on the appeal form.
wikioasissafety-appeal-text-help: Help text under the appeal textarea.
wikioasissafety-appeal-submit: Submit button on the appeal form. {{Identical|Send}}
wikioasissafety-appeal-sent: Confirmation that an appeal was sent. $1 is the reference.
wikioasissafety-appeal-duplicate: Shown when an appeal against the same action is already open. $1 is the existing reference.
wikioasissafety-appeal-queued: Shown when an appeal was saved for later delivery because the portal was unreachable.
notification-header-wikioasissafety-case: Echo notification: a report has been received. $1 is the reference.
Echo notification: a case changed status. $1 is the reference.
notification-header-wikioasissafety-comm: Echo notification: Trust & Safety replied. $1 is the reference.
notification-header-wikioasissafety-acti: Echo notification: an action was taken. $1 is the action's name, $2 the reference.
Echo notification: an action was lifted. $1 is the action's name, $2 the reference.
notification-body-wikioasissafety: Body of every Trust & Safety notification. Deliberately says nothing about the case: notification text appears in popups and emails.
notification-link-wikioasissafety: Label of the link on a Trust & Safety notification.
echo-category-title-wikioasissafety: Name of the Trust & Safety notification category in preferences.
echo-pref-tooltip-wikioasissafety: Tooltip for the Trust & Safety notification category in preferences.
apierror-wikioasissafety-nofile: API error from action=wikioasissafetyupload when the request carried no readable file. Seen by a script rather than by a reporter: the wizard reports a failed upload with {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-file-uploadfailed}} instead.
apierror-wikioasissafety-unsignedparam: API error shown when a signed request from the portal carries one of the module's own parameters in the URL rather than in the request body. $1 is a comma-separated list of the parameter names. The signature covers the body and the path but not the query string, so a parameter that arrives there is one nobody signed. See includes/Portal/SignedParameters.php.
apierror-wikioasissafety-taskfailed:
Error returned when an enforce task reported a problem. $1 is the reason, from the task itself.

This exists because those reasons used to be returned inside a reply that also said the task had succeeded — so the portal recorded an erasure as under way when the wiki had in fact refused it, and then waited a day for a rename that was never queued. The portal reads MediaWiki's own `error` shape, so dying here is what gets the reason onto the record.
apierror-wikioasissafety-tasknotready:
Error returned when an enforce task cannot proceed *yet* — a rename that has not finished, a portal that could not be reached, a database briefly unavailable. $1 is the reason.

Distinct from {{msg-mw|apierror-wikioasissafety-taskfailed}}, which is a refusal. The portal reads the error code: this one makes it back off and keep the erasure's place, that one makes it record a failure straight away. Reporting both as one code is what made an erasure abandon itself while the wiki was still renaming.
wikioasissafety-checkuser-nolog: Shown when the CheckUser push script runs on a wiki that does not have the CheckUser extension installed.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-category: Label in the report detail view on Special:SafetyHome for the categories Trust & Safety filed a report or message under. Followed by a comma-separated list of category names.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-agai: Label in the facts list of an appeal on Special:SafetyHome, naming the action being appealed. Followed by {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-action}}.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-acti:
One action, as the reference and what it was. Parameters:
* $1 - the action's reference, e.g. AC-2026-0119
* $2 - what the action was, e.g. "Account suspension"
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-info: Chip beside the appealed action on Special:SafetyHome, shown while the action still applies. See also {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-lifted}}.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-lift: Chip beside the appealed action on Special:SafetyHome, shown once the action no longer applies. See also {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-inforce}}.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-reas: Label for the reason that was given for the action being appealed, in the facts list of an appeal on Special:SafetyHome.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-appl: Label for where the action being appealed applies — a list of wikis, or the whole farm.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-outc: Label for what was decided about an appeal, in the facts list on Special:SafetyHome.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-unde: Shown as the outcome of an appeal nobody has decided yet. Deliberately not left blank: an empty outcome reads as though the appeal were being ignored.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-unma: Shown on an appeal that Trust & Safety could not match to a particular action. Asks the reader for the reference, because they are the one person who knows which action they meant.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-outc: One outcome of an appeal: the action was undone. See also {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-outcome-declined}}.
One outcome of an appeal: the action was changed but not removed — shortened, narrowed, or downgraded.
One outcome of an appeal: it was considered and refused, and the action remains.
One outcome of an appeal: the person who filed it asked for it to be closed.
One outcome of an appeal: there was no action against the account for it to be about.
wikioasissafety-flow-triage-title: Title of the wizard's first step, which asks whether the reader wants guidance on user behaviour or wants to file a report with Trust & Safety.
wikioasissafety-flow-triage-description: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-triage-title}}, saying what the two questions on the step are for.
wikioasissafety-flow-help-label: Label of the first triage question. The reader answers either this question or {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-label}}, never both.
wikioasissafety-flow-help-unacceptable: The only option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-help-label}}. Choosing it leads to the guidance step rather than to a report.
wikioasissafety-flow-help-unacceptable-d: Description under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-help-unacceptable}} option, listing what it covers.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-label: Label of the second triage question, whose options are the kinds of report Trust & Safety takes. The answer is what the rest of the flow branches on.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage: An option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-label}}, for reporting somebody below the minimum age for an account. "WikiOasis" is the name of the wiki farm and is not translated.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-other: The catch-all option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-label}}. Choosing it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-other-followup}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-other-follow: Label of the required text box that appears under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-other}} option.
wikioasissafety-flow-subject-title: Title of the step that asks what a report is about: pages, users, wikis, and which ones.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-label: Label of the checkbox group on the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-subject-title}} step. Each box ticked reveals a field naming the pages, users or wikis concerned.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-pages: A checkbox under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-label}}. Ticking it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-pages-label}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-pages-desc: Description under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-pages}} checkbox. No full stop, to match the checkboxes beside it.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-users: A checkbox under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-label}}. Ticking it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-users-label}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-users-desc: Description under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-users}} checkbox. No full stop, to match the checkboxes beside it.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-wikis: A checkbox under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-label}}. Ticking it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-wikis-label}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-wikis-desc: Description under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-wikis}} checkbox. No full stop, to match the checkboxes beside it.
wikioasissafety-flow-pages-label: Label of the field naming the pages a report is about. Shown only when {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-pages}} is ticked.
wikioasissafety-flow-pages-description: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-pages-label}}. The field suggests titles on this wiki but accepts anything typed, because a report may name a page that has already been deleted.
wikioasissafety-flow-users-label: Label of the field naming the users a report is about. Shown only when {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-users}} is ticked.
wikioasissafety-flow-users-description: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-users-label}}. The field suggests registered accounts but accepts anything typed, because unregistered editors are named by their IP address.
wikioasissafety-flow-wikis-label: Label of the field naming the wikis a report is about. Shown only when {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-wikis}} is ticked.
wikioasissafety-flow-details-title: Title of the step that asks what happened, asks whatever the kind of report chosen at triage raises, and takes attachments.
wikioasissafety-flow-details-label: Label of the required box holding the reporter's account of what happened. The one field in the flow nothing else can stand in for.
wikioasissafety-flow-attachments-label: Label of the optional file upload on the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-details-title}} step.
wikioasissafety-flow-yes: An answer to a yes/no question in the wizard. Used by several questions, so keep it a bare answer rather than a sentence about any one of them.
wikioasissafety-flow-no: An answer to a yes/no question in the wizard. Used by several questions, so keep it a bare answer rather than a sentence about any one of them.
wikioasissafety-flow-unsure: An answer offered beside {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-yes}} and {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-no}}, so that a reporter who does not know is not made to guess. Used by several questions.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-la: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-threat}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-de: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-label}}, saying why the question is asked.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-authorities-: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-threat}} at triage. Answered with {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-yes}}, {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-no}} or {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-unsure}}.
Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-threat-authorities-label}}. It must not read as advice to wait for Trust & Safety.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-where-label: Label of an optional field shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-threat}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-licensing-standing-: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-licensing}} at triage. Whether the reporter holds the rights decides what Trust & Safety may act on.
An option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-licensing-standing-label}}, for somebody reporting a copy they have no stake in.
wikioasissafety-flow-licensing-source-la: Label of an optional field shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-licensing}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-notice: A notice shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-child}} at triage. Rendered as plain text in a notice box, so it may not contain markup.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-nature-label: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-child}} at triage. Its answer decides who the report reaches first.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-authorities-l: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-child}} at triage. Answered with {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-yes}}, {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-no}} or {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-unsure}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-authorities-d: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-child-authorities-label}}. It exists so that "no" does not read as an admission.
wikioasissafety-flow-harassment-target-l: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-harassment}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-harassment-where-la: Label of a checkbox group shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-harassment}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-harassment-where-of: A checkbox under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-harassment-where-label}}, for harassment on other sites, by email, or in person.
wikioasissafety-flow-harassment-ongoing-: Label of a question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-harassment}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-notice: A notice shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage}} at triage. The report is about a child, so it must not become the place their personal details are collected. Rendered as plain text in a notice box, so it may not contain markup.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-labe: Label of a required question shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-othe: The catch-all option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-label}}. Choosing it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-other-followup}}.
Label of the required text box that appears under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-other}} option.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-where-labe: Label of an optional field shown on the report details step only when the reporter chose {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage}} at triage.
wikioasissafety-flow-final-title: Title of the wizard's final step, which asks the two questions that change how a report is handled.
wikioasissafety-flow-threattolife-label: Label of the checkbox on the final step that marks a report urgent. Deliberately long: ticking it has to be a considered act.
wikioasissafety-flow-anonymous-label: Label of the toggle on the final step that files a report without attaching it to the reporter's account.
wikioasissafety-flow-anonymous-descripti: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-anonymous-label}}, saying what filing anonymously costs.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-title: Title of the guidance step, reached by answering {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-help-unacceptable}} at triage. The step collects nothing and points at community processes instead.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-next: The guidance step's forward button. It closes the wizard rather than submitting anything, so it must not read like "send".
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-back: The guidance step's back button, which returns to the triage step.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-sockpuppet: Title of a guidance card. Abuse of multiple accounts.
Description on the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-sockpuppetry}} card. Rendered as plain text, so the address and the noticeboard are described rather than linked.
wikioasissafety-category-threat-of-physi: Name of the category a report is counted under in a transparency report. Shorter than the option that produces it, because it is read in a table.
wikioasissafety-category-a-child-protect: Name of the category a report is counted under in a transparency report.
wikioasissafety-category-harassment: Name of the category a report is counted under in a transparency report.
wikioasissafety-category-a-licensing-iss: Name of the category a report is counted under in a transparency report.
wikioasissafety-category-underage-user: Name of the category a report is counted under in a transparency report, for an account held by somebody below the minimum age.
wikioasissafety-category-something-else: Name of the catch-all category. Worth counting rather than leaving blank: "we received 40 reports that fitted no category" is a fact about the categories.
wikioasissafety-category-unacceptable: Name of the category for a report filed through the guidance branch, where the reader had been pointed at a community noticeboard instead. Declared so the few who file anyway are not counted as {{msg-wikioasissafety-category-something-else}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-title: Title of the "manage my data" wizard, reached from its card on Special:SafetyHome.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-submit: The button that submits the "manage my data" wizard, in place of the report flow's {{msg-wikioasissafety-submit}}.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-copy-elsewhere: A notice at the top of the only step of the "manage my data" wizard, which asks for data to be deleted. It is there for the reader who came looking for a copy of their data instead: that is not requested through the wizard and is answered by email. The address is an example and a wiki should replace it with its own.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-title: Title of the step reached by asking for data to be deleted.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-descript: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-title}}. It says exactly what an erasure does and does not do, because the alternative is somebody believing their edits are going as well.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-details-: Label of the optional free-text box on the data erasure step.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-confirm-: Label of the checkbox that has to be ticked before a data erasure request can be sent.
wikioasissafety-category-data-erasure: Name of the category a data request is counted under in a transparency report.
wikioasissafety-category-data-rectificat: Name of the category a data request is counted under in a transparency report: a correction to data held.
wikioasissafety-category-data-other: Name of the catch-all category for data requests.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-title: Title of the "contact Trust & Safety" wizard, reached from its card on Special:SafetyHome.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-submit: The button that submits the "contact Trust & Safety" wizard. Nothing is being reported, so it does not say "submit report".
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-titl: Title of the first step of the "contact Trust & Safety" wizard.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-labe: Label of the question that decides which branch of the "contact Trust & Safety" wizard the reader takes.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-appe: An option under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-label}}. The account standing page opens the wizard straight at this answer.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-message-tit: Title of the step that takes a general message to Trust & Safety.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-subject-lab: Label of the required one-line subject field on the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-contact-message-title}} step.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-message-lab: Label of the required message box on the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-contact-message-title}} step.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-attachments: Label of the optional file upload on the message and appeal steps of the "contact Trust & Safety" wizard.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-titl: Title of the step that takes an appeal against an action on the reader's account.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-targ: Label of the menu naming which action an appeal is against. Its choices are the reader's own sanctions and cannot be written down in configuration.
The unchosen state of the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-target-label}} menu.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-grou: Label of the required box holding the grounds for an appeal.
wikioasissafety-category-contact-general: Name of the category a message to Trust & Safety is counted under in a transparency report.
wikioasissafety-category-contact-appeal: Name of the category a message to Trust & Safety is counted under in a transparency report. The figure a reader of one looks for: how many people asked us to look again.
wikioasissafety-category-contact-other: Name of the catch-all category for messages to Trust & Safety.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-in: Description under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-title}} on a flow that lets the reader choose what to erase, rather than erasing everything in one operation. See also {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-description}}, which is the wording for a flow that does not offer the choice.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-la: Label of the checkbox group naming which kinds of personal data an erasure request covers.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-ot: The catch-all checkbox under {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-label}}. Ticking it reveals {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-other-followup}}.
Label of the required text box that appears under the {{msg-wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-other}} checkbox.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-co: Label of the checkbox that has to be ticked before an erasure request that names what to delete can be sent.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-kind-title: Title of the step in the manage-my-data wizard that asks what the reader wants done with their data.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-kind-descripti: Description under {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-flow-data-kind-title}}. Says that this form only handles deletion, and points requests for a copy at the contact form, because the portal does not answer those.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-request-label: Label for the list of things the reader can ask for in the manage-my-data wizard.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-request-erase: One option in the manage-my-data wizard: deletion of the personal data held about the reader.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-request-erase-: Description of {{msg-mw|wikioasissafety-flow-data-request-erase}}. Says what deletion does and does not cover — the personal data goes, the edits remain.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-more-label: Label for the free-text field in the manage-my-data wizard where the reader can add anything else about their request.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-me: One option for how far a deletion request reaches: everything held across WikiOasis for the account, rather than one wiki.
